_schema.description: KDM-003 allowlist of KNOWN, ACCEPTED Python<->.NET differential differences. Each entry temporarily exempts one fixture id from cross-runtime parity. Empty today because the .NET runtime does not exist yet (KDM-005+); entries are added only when a real, justified difference is found during KDM-034 rehearsal. An expired entry FAILS the test, forcing re-review.

entry_fields.fixture_id: id from fixtures.json this diff applies to
entry_fields.owner: GitHub handle accountable for resolving/renewing it
entry_fields.reason: why the difference is acceptable for now
entry_fields.expires: YYYY-MM-DD; after this date the test fails until resolved or renewed
entry_fields.tracking_issue: KDM issue URL where the resolution is tracked
